paragraphs.text: Notion for DeepSeek Harness: MCP OAuth connection, 12 Notion skills, multi-workspace settings UI
# dsh-notion-plugin

Use Notion from DeepSeek Harness
(DSH): a hosted MCP connection, 12 Notion Cookbook skills, and a se

ttings page
for multiple workspaces.

A DSH port of Notion's official
`claude-code-notion-plugin`.
## What you get

- **Notion MCP tools** — search, read, create, and edit pages and databases via
Notion's hosted MCP

server (`https://mcp.notion.com/mcp`).
- **12 skills** — e.g. `notion-database-designer`, `notion-me

eting-intelligence`,
`notion-research-documentation`, `notion-knowledge-capture`.
- **Multi-workspac

e** — connect several workspaces; one is active at a time.
The agent can list and switch with `notio

n_list_workspaces` / `notion_use_workspace`.
- **`notion_open_page`** — open a result in the desktop

right-sidebar browser
(or a new tab elsewhere).
- **`notion_current_page`** — return the URL and pa

ge id of the page open in the
sidebar browser, so the agent can answer "what does this page say?" by

reading
it. Reflects pages opened through Notion tools.

There are no slash commands: DSH runs commands locally without sending them to
the model, so the ski
lls plus natural language replace them.
## Install

Install this directory as a DSH bundle (`plugin_manager` → `install_bundle`,
target = this folder).
It is not published to a registry.
## Connect a workspace

Open the plugin's **Settings** page and press **Connect**. The plugin runs
Notion's OAuth (dynamic c

lient registration + PKCE) on a local callback
(`http://localhost:53682/callback`) and forwards MCP

traffic through a local
proxy (`http://localhost:53683/mcp`) that injects and refreshes the token fo

r
the active account. Use **Open Notion** to sign in once in the sidebar browser.

> A Notion "login" connection created in the Notion UI is not a valid MCP
> client — only dynamicall
y registered clients are accepted.

## Known limitation

The desktop sidebar browser uses a non-persistent session, so you sign in to
Notion again after each

app restart. Persistent login would need the host to
use a `persist:` session partition.
## Credits
Skills and MCP server by Notion. Ported to DSH as a Cordis bundle.
